title: Thomas Edison: Inventor and Busy Team Leader
speaker: VOA Learning English

sentences.en: The inventor Thomas Alva Edison had a major effect on the lives of people around the world.
sentences.zh: 发明家托马斯·阿尔瓦·爱迪生对全世界人民的生活产生了重大影响。

sentences.en: Thomas Edison is remembered most for the electric light, his phonograph , and his work with motion pictures.
sentences.zh: 托马斯·爱迪生最记得的是电灯、他的录音机和电影作品。

sentences.en: Edison was born on February 11, 1847, in Milan, Ohio.
sentences.zh: 爱迪生于1847年2月11日 俄亥俄州米兰

sentences.en: He was mostly self-taught. His mother taught him reading, writing, and mathematics.
sentences.zh: 他大部分是自学的,他的母亲教他读书、写作和数学。

sentences.en: He learned from books, and he experimented.
sentences.zh: 他从书中学习,并进行了实验。

sentences.en: At the age of 10, he experimented with chemicals and electricity.
sentences.zh: 10岁时,他实验化学和电力。

sentences.en: He built a telegraph machine and, at the age of 16, he went to work as a telegraph operator.
sentences.zh: 他造了一台电报机 16岁时,他去当电报接线员

sentences.en: He continued his work with electricity, making improved telegraph machines, and he invented an electrical voting machine.
sentences.zh: 他继续用电 改进了电报机 发明了一台电子投票机

sentences.en: Edison earned enough money from his early inventions to start his own company in 1871.
sentences.zh: 爱迪生从早期发明中赚到的钱 足以在1871年创办自己的公司

sentences.en: Instead of working alone, he worked with a group of employees on many different projects at one time.
sentences.zh: 他一次不是单独工作,而是与一组雇员在很多不同项目上工作。

sentences.en: They asked the United States government for patents to protect more than one hundred devices or inventions each year.
sentences.zh: 他们要求美国政府提供专利,以便每年保护100多个装置或发明。

sentences.en: He was an extremely busy man. In 1913, a popular magazine at the time called Thomas Edison the most useful man in America.
sentences.zh: 1913年,一个叫托马斯·爱迪生的杂志 在美国最有用

sentences.en: He almost never slept more than four or five hours a night.
sentences.zh: 他几乎每晚睡不着超过四、五个小时

sentences.en: He usually worked 18 hours each day because he enjoyed what he was doing.
sentences.zh: 他通常每天工作18小时,因为他喜欢他的工作。

sentences.en: A reporter asked Edison in 1917 which of his many inventions he enjoyed the most.
sentences.zh: 1917年,一位记者问爱迪生,他最欣赏的发明是什么。

sentences.en: He answered, the phonograph was really the most interesting.
sentences.zh: 他回答说,录音机真的很有趣。

sentences.en: The hardest invention to develop, he said, was the electric light.
sentences.zh: 他说,最难开发的发明是电灯。

sentences.en: He said that it was the most difficult and the most important.
sentences.zh: 他说,这是最困难和最重要的。

sentences.en: He also invented the modern motion picture film.
sentences.zh: 他还发明了现代电影电影

sentences.en: In 1928, he received a special medal of honor from the Congress of the United States.
sentences.zh: 1928年,他获得美国国会特别荣誉奖章。

sentences.en: Thomas Edison died on January 6, 1931. People worldwide have had easier and more enjoyable lives because of his inventions.
sentences.zh: 托马斯·爱迪生于1931年1月6日去世,全世界人民由于他的发明而过着更容易、更愉快的生活。

sentences.en: I’m John Russell. Paul Thompson reported this story for VOA’s People in America program.
sentences.zh: 我是John Russell。Paul Thompson为美国人民之声的节目报导了这个故事。

sentences.en: Jill Robbins adapted it for Learning English.
sentences.zh: 吉尔・罗宾斯改编了它 学习英语。
